summary: Thread suspension guarded by a mutex. If the thread handle this+0x4 is NULL, returns success (1). Otherwise waits on the mutex this+0x20 with timeout this+0x24 (WAIT_OBJECT_0 or WAIT_TIMEOUT both accepted), and if the suspend flag this+0x1C is not already set, retries SuspendThread(this+0x4) up to 50 times with increasing Sleep delays until the thread reports a non-zero previous suspend count. On success sets the suspend flag this+0x1C to 1; on timeout after 50 attempts returns failure (0). Always releases the mutex if present. Part of the ai subsystem.

local_names.v2: retry attempt counter (also Sleep delay in ms)

operations.description: If thread handle this+0x4 is NULL, return success (1) immediately.
Wait on mutex this+0x20 with timeout this+0x24 via WaitForSingleObject; treat return 0 (WAIT_OBJECT_0) or 128 (WAIT_TIMEOUT) as mutex acquired.
If suspend flag this+0x1C is already non-zero (thread suspended), skip the suspend loop.

Retry SuspendThread(this+0x4) up to 50 times, sleeping the attempt count in ms via Sleep between retries; break out early when the call returns a non-zero previous suspend count; fail (v8=0) after 50 attempts that all returned 0.
Set suspend flag this+0x1C to 1 after a successful suspend.
Release the mutex this+0x20 via ReleaseMutex if present.
Return success flag (1 on success, 0 on failure after 50 failed suspend attempts).

unresolved: SuspendThread returning a non-zero previous suspend count is treated as the success condition; a first-time suspend (count 0) is retried until it reports a prior count or the 50-attempt cap fails.
Owner object (thread + mutex + flag grouping) is unconfirmed; evidence shows only field offsets, not a class.
The four WinAPI imports are referenced at their IAT global addresses; direct call targets are not listed as callee entries in the packet.
